name: Commercial Law
seo_title: UGC NET Law Commercial Law Notes (Unit 6): Contract to CSR
description: UGC NET Law Commercial Law notes: 12 topics, 72 sub-topics on contract, sale of goods, partnership, NI Act, company law and CSR. Free, with revision mode.
intro: Commercial Law is a high-scoring unit built on statutes, section numbers and time limits as much as on cases. The notes follow the syllabus: the Indian Contract Act (formation, breach, quasi-contract, specific contracts), the Sale of Goods Act, Partnership and LLP, the Negotiable Instruments Act, Company Law (incorporation, shares, directors, meetings) and CSR. Topic 0 explains how the unit is tested and Topic 11 collects the priority order, a numbers and time-limits cheat sheet, a landmark-case master list and a revision plan.
how: Start with Topic 0, then go through Topics 1 to 10. Company Law (Topics 8 and 9) usually carries the most questions, so give it the most time; learn definitions, numbers and thresholds.
Switch on Revision mode on any topic page to keep each section's key terms, lists and tables. Use the Exam Pointers at the end of Topic 5 and the priority order in Topic 11.
Use the rapid-recall sheet (numbers, time limits and the case master list), then the recent amendments in Topic 11 and practice MCQs.
